instruction: Switch to the Chrome browser and navigate to the Wikipedia tab.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened LibreOffice Calc, correctly identified B6='Nereida', switched to Chrome, attempted Google search for 'Nereida' but hit SSL certificate errors (NET::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID). Spent remaining turns trying alternative approaches (DuckDuckGo, file manager, new tabs) but never successfully completed the search.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc cells, read cell values, switch between applications, switch Chrome tabs, type in URL bar and search bars, open new tabs
metadata.failure_analysis: Failed due to SSL certificate errors on google.com in the VM environment. The model correctly formed the search URL with the right query ('Nereida') but the page returned a privacy error instead of search results.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single-step Chrome tab switching task within the model's demonstrated capability. Avoids SSL issues by not requiring external website navigation.
metadata.explanation: Task requires switching from LibreOffice Calc to Chrome and activating the Wikipedia tab. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the Wikipedia Main Page URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_tab_info' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab info including URL via the Chrome debugging protocol.
Metric 'is_expected_active_tab' correctly receives the rules dict (type=url, url=...) and compares the active tab URL against the expected Wikipedia URL using compare_urls.
Expected URL 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page' matches exactly the URL opened in the config's chrome_open_tabs setup.
Coverage is complete: verifying the active tab is the Wikipedia page implicitly confirms both switching to Chrome and navigating to the Wikipedia tab.
No postconfig is needed since the getter reads Chrome state via the debugging port, which is always accessible.
